description: Federal Highway Administration Scenario Planning Guidebook is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by DOT Federal Highway Administration. This guidebook introduces scenario planning as a strategy to support and advance performance-based planning and programming (PBPP). The guidebook presents a framework for connecting established scenario planning processes with the four phases of PBPP: direction, analysis, programming, and implementation. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Flooding – General, Landslides. Assets: Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
